title: radar.raman: Raman Spectral Analysis Using Deep Learning for Artifact Removal (R package)
description:
radar.raman is an R package that decomposes Raman spectra into four additive components — baseline, cosmic rays, noise and Raman peaks — using convolutional neural networks.

  • Two pretrained networks, standard and ensemble, bundled as native R objects; no download or conversion is needed.
  • Neural network inference, automatic differentiation, Adam training, synthetic data generation and evaluation metrics, implemented entirely in R with no compiled code.
  • Readers and writers for common spectroscopy and scientific formats: CSV/TSV/text, RRUFF, RDS, SPC, JCAMP-DX, NumPy, Renishaw WDF, and, with optional packages, JSON, MATLAB, HDF5/NetCDF-4, SQLite, Excel, Parquet and Arrow IPC, and Horiba LabSpec and Princeton TriVista XML.
  • Spectral map operations, an Rscript command-line entry point, a testthat suite and two vignettes.

A port of the Python radar-raman package. The network architectures, the synthetic data generator and the pretrained weights come from the original implementation by Joel Sjöberg; the regression fixtures are outputs of that original code, so the test suite checks this port against it rather than against itself.
